options.name: --loom-memory-bytes
options.help: Budget for an elastic Loom memory pool (weights and state); default: none, a fixed pool committed at load

options.name: --loom-logits
options.help: Logits readback for host sampling (grammars, logprobs, min-p, penalties): auto, on or off (default: auto, on when the package declares it)

options.name: --loom-preset
options.help: Preset of the Loom package to serve (default: the one the package publishes for this GPU)

options.name: --loom-checkpoint
options.help: The package's GGUF checkpoint files when they are not in the model directory: a file, or a directory holding them at their repository paths (default: the model directory, where gufo model install puts them)

options.name: --loom-drafter
options.help: The package's draft model files when they are not in the model directory: a file, or a directory holding them at their repository paths (default: the model directory, where gufo model install puts them)

options.name: --loom-vision
options.help: The package's vision projector files when they are not in the model directory: a file, or a directory holding them at their repository paths (default: the model directory, where gufo model install puts them)
